summary: CR-077 Phase 1 Receive Stock screen QA (V1-V8). Found and fixed 1 CRITICAL bug (ReferenceError: useContext is not defined that made /inventory-receive crash to ErrorBoundary — missing import in ReceiveStockPanel.jsx). After fix, all 8 verification items PASS: route renders with correct header + truck icon, sidebar Receive pill correctly visible for Palm India (franchise) & hidden for Kunafa (normal), queue table columns match mockup (Reference/From/Dispatched/Lines-Items/Status/Actions), 2 pending transfers rendered (TRF-813-2026-0004 id=296 Granola, TRF-813-2026-0002 id=293), drawer opens with orange border rgb(249,115,22) showing line items with batch (GRANOLA-20260717-001) + expiry (Feb 27, 2027) + Confirm Receive/Reject All/Cancel/Close buttons, Confirm Receive on transfer 296 succeeded (queue refresh: 2→1 rows, transfer 293 preserved for owner smoke testing per instructions), My Requests tab displays transfers correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by test agent — line 31 used useContext(RestaurantContext) but neither useContext (react) nor RestaurantContext were imported. Import statement on line 6 correctly imports useRestaurant hook, but the code never used it. Changed to `useRestaurant()` (the already-imported hook). Without this fix, page crashed with ErrorBoundary 'ReferenceError: useContext is not defined' and V1-V8 could not be tested.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking [data-testid='drawer-submit'] on transfer 296, the queue refreshed correctly (row 296 removed, count 2→1) but no sonner toast text was captured in DOM at the time of the post-click evaluation. Behavior is likely correct (toast may have already auto-dismissed by then); the functional path is verified via queue refresh. Not blocking.

issues: Route is NOT guarded on the frontend — a non-franchise/normal restaurant user who deep-links directly to /inventory-receive still sees the full Receive Dispatched Stock page (empty state, 0 pending). Only the sidebar nav pill is hidden. Consider either (a) protecting the route via a ProtectedRoute variant that redirects non-franchise/master users to /inventory-dashboard, or (b) rendering an 'Unavailable for your restaurant type' banner. Backend will likely return empty queues so no data leak, but UX-wise the screen shouldn't appear for normal outlets.

test_results.V4 Pending queue loads: PASS — Receive Pending tab badge showed count 2 initially, with 2 rows: TRF-813-2026-0004 (id=296, palm india, Restaurant #813, Jul 19 · 3:50 PM, 1 lines · 1 items, Dispatched) and TRF-813-2026-0002 (id=293, Jul 17 · 11:02 AM).
test_results.V5 Queue columns: PASS — Table thead exactly: ['Reference', 'From', 'Dispatched', 'Lines / Items', 'Status', 'Actions'] — pixel-matches v5 mockup.

Line item: 'Granola · Line 1 · Category: 1694 · 1.00 kg (1000 gm) · GRANOLA-20260717-001 · exp: Feb 27, 2027 · Received Qty 1.00 kg · unit: kg · fully received'. Drawer footer shows Cancel, Reject All ([data-testid='drawer-reject']), Confirm Receive ([data-testid='drawer-submit']) and X close ([data-testid='close-drawer']).
test_results.V7 Confirm Receive works: PASS — Clicked [data-testid='drawer-submit'] on transfer 296. Post-click queue refresh: rows_before=2 → rows_after=1, transfer-row-296 no longer present, transfer-row-293 preserved (per instructions). POST /api/inventory-transfer/receive/296 clearly succeeded based on optimistic queue behavior and no console errors. Note: sonner toast text not captured in DOM at re-check, but behavior confirms success.
test_results.V8 My Requests tab: PASS — Clicked [data-testid='tab-my-requests'] and observed 2 rows (matches Palm India's transfers list). Tab badge showed count 2. Rows correctly rendered under active tab.

action_items: LOW/MEDIUM: Consider guarding /inventory-receive route on frontend so non-franchise/master users cannot deep-link into it (currently sidebar hides the pill but route still renders). Suggestion: wrap route with a check on restaurantTypeFlag and redirect to /inventory-dashboard, mirroring the sidebar featureGate='restaurantTypeFlagged' logic.

LOW: (optional) Verify sonner toast is rendering with configured duration; may want to bump duration slightly or add a data-testid to the success toast for future regression tests. Behavior is functionally correct.
INFO: Transfer 293 (TRF-813-2026-0002, Chocolate Sauce family) is intentionally left in dispatched state per handoff instructions for owner smoke testing.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: /app/frontend/src/components/inventory/ReceiveStockPanel.jsx line 31 originally read `const { restaurant, restaurantTypeFlag } = useContext(RestaurantContext) || {};` but neither useContext nor RestaurantContext were imported (import on line 6 correctly pulled in useRestaurant which was unused). This caused the entire /inventory-receive route to fall to ErrorBoundary. Fixed to use the already-imported `useRestaurant()` hook. Recommend a lint rule (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps + no-undef via eslint) if not already enabled to catch this class of bug at build time.

ReceiveStockPanel.jsx / ReceiveDrawer.jsx are cleanly structured (~200 lines each), use data-testid consistently on all interactive elements, integrate with transferService for network calls, and correctly refresh the queue via onAction callback after a successful receive.
InventoryReceivePage.jsx page wrapper is minimal and correct — Sidebar + main + max-w-7xl container. No issues.
The Receive route uses only the sidebar featureGate for gating; the page itself renders unconditionally. See action_items above.

V6 drawer's 'Reject reason' input (data-testid='reject-reason-input') was not tested end-to-end (not part of V1-V8 scope); recommend a Phase 2 test to exercise the reject path since it exists in code (handleReject calls transferService.rejectTransfer with a reason).
